name: Combobox
description: A searchable dropdown select that replaces the native select for complex use cases. Supports single and multi-select, creatable options, and keyboard navigation. Uses Portal for the dropdown to avoid overflow clipping.

keyboardInteraction: ArrowDown — open listbox / move to next option
Enter — select focused option / create new option
Backspace — remove last selected tag in multi mode when input is empty
notes: Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus) and a 2px offset.
Disabled options are not focusable via arrow keys.
Screen readers announce the focused option via aria-activedescendant.

options.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

onInputChange.description: Called when the search input text changes.

multi.description: Enables multi-select mode. Selected items render as tags.

creatable.description: Allows creating new options that are not in the list.

onCreate.description: Called when a new option is created (creatable mode).

clearable.description: Shows a clear button to reset the selection.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

size.description: Controls the combobox height, padding, and font size.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

do: Use for lists with more than ~10 options where search is helpful.
Use multi mode when users need to select multiple items.
Use creatable when users should be able to add custom values.
Provide a meaningful placeholder to guide users.
dont: Do not use for simple lists with fewer than 5 options — use Select instead.
Do not use without an accessible label.
Do not use creatable without an onCreate handler.
